definitions.gloss: skilled worker; experienced craftsman; master artisan
definitions.explanation: A worker who has achieved a high level of skill and expertise through extensive training and experience, particularly in manufacturing or craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{機械|きかい}では{再現|さいげん}できない。
examples.english: The skills of a master craftsman cannot be replicated by machines.

examples.japanese: {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}が{不足|ふそく}しているのが{課題|かだい}だ。
examples.english: A shortage of skilled workers is the challenge.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{世代|せだい}に{熟練工|じゅくれんこう}の{技|わざ}をどう{伝|つた}えるかが{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: How to pass on the skills of experienced craftsmen to the younger generation has become an issue.

notes: A compound of {熟練|じゅくれん} (mastery, skill through experience) and {工|こう} (worker, craftsman). Japan's manufacturing sector has long depended on {熟練工|じゅくれんこう}, and the aging and retirement of these workers is a significant social issue known as the {技術|ぎじゅつ}{伝承|でんしょう} (technology succession) problem. Compare with {職人|しょくにん} (craftsman, artisan, broader term) and {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ} (engineer, technician).
